name: Annoying Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose any player. That player must DISCARD a card. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

name: Black Knight Unicorn
description: If 1 of your Unicorn cards would be destroyed, you may SACRIFICE this card instead.

name: Chainsaw Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may SACRIFICE or DESTROY an Upgrade or Downgrade card.

name: Classy Narwhal
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for an Upgrade card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the deck.

name: Dark Angel Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

description: When this card enters your Stable, each player must SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.

description: When this card enters your Stable, DRAW a card. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

name: Llamacorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, each player must DISCARD a card. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

name: Magical Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose a Magic card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

name: Magical Kittencorn
description: This card cannot be destroyed or otherwise affected by Magic cards.

name: Majestic Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose a Unicorn card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

name: Mother Goose Unicorn

name: Mermaid Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose any player. Return a card in that player's Stable to their hand.

name: Narwhal Torpedo
description: When this card enters your Stable, SACRIFICE all Downgrade cards.

name: Necromancer Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may DISCARD 2 Unicorn cards, then bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

name: Queen Bee Unicorn
description: Basic Unicorn cards cannot enter any player's Stable except yours.

name: Rainbow Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may bring a Basic Unicorn card from your hand directly into your Stable.

name: Rhinocorn
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DESTROY a Unicorn card. If you do, immediately skip to your End of Turn phase.

name: Seductive Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may DISCARD a card, then STEAL a Unicorn card.

name: Shark With A Horn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may SACRIFICE this card, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Stabby The Unicorn
description: If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, you may DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Swifty Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may add a Neigh card from the discard pile to your hand. If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand.

name: The Great Narwhal
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a card with "Narwhal" in its name and add it to yoru hand, then shuffle the deck.

name: Unicorn On The Cob
description: When this card enters your Stable, DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD a card.

name: Unicorn Oracle
description: When this card enters your Stable, look at the top 3 cards of the deck and add one of them to your hand, then return the other two to the top of the deck in any order.

name: Unicorn Phoenix
description: If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, you may DISCARD a card instead.

name: Back Kick
description: Choose any player. Return a card in that player's Stable to their hand. That player must DISCARD a card.

name: Blatant Thievery
description: Choose any player and look at that player's hand. Choose a card from that player's hand and add it to your hand.

name: Change Of Luck
description: DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD 3 cards, then take another turn.

name: Glitter Tornado
description: Return a card in each player's Stable to that player's hand.

name: Good Deal
description: DRAW 3 cards and DISCARD a card.

name: Kiss Of Life
description: Bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

name: Mystical Vortex
description: Each player must DISCARD a card. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

name: Shake Up
description: Shuffle this card, your hand, and the discard pile into the deck. DRAW 5 cards.

name: Unicorn Poison
description: DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Neigh
description: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile.

name: Super Neigh
description: Play this card when any other player tries to play a card. Stop that player's card from being played and send it to the discard pile. This card cannot be Neigh'd.
